capabilities: Provide a customizable Office-style ribbon with tabs, groups and command buttons
Hide Markdown syntax while typing with a formatting Quick Bar for selections
Add OneNote-style note tags with a tags summary across section, notebook or vault
Create indented subpages from a parent property instead of folders
Show notebooks, section tabs and page lists built from vault folders
disambiguation: Not a CSS theme; the same-named OneNote Style theme is a separate companion theme in the same suite.
extras: Part of the Sundowna Second Brain Suite (with AI ChatBridge and the OneNote Style theme). Desktop only, needs Obsidian 1.10.6 or newer. By default it sets a purple accent, Segoe UI and Calibri unless 'OneNote theme' is turned off. No network calls or telemetry. Some OneNote features are explicitly not possible: click-anywhere canvas, ink, audio recording and OneNote import.
motivation: The author came from Office and found Obsidian's command-palette-driven workflow friction; the plugin is part of the Sundowna Second Brain Suite to make Obsidian feel low-friction.
problem: Obsidian's power sits behind the command palette and hotkeys, and Markdown syntax on screen, which is friction for people used to Office-style toolbars and formatted editing.

relations.evidence: Its AI group runs AI ChatBridge's sync commands with one click
the same format as the Highlightr plugin
Subpages in Notebook Navigator are indented and marked, but that plugin keeps its own sort order.
if you have them, AI ChatBridge, Editing Toolbar, Excalidraw, Tasks, Omnisearch and Notebook Navigator

summary: Customizable Office-style ribbon of tabs, groups and command buttons for any command, plus OneNote-like editing, note tags, subpages and notebooks.
